regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your favor of April 29. Please pardon delayed ac- knowledgement. Thank the good God for your improvement reported. May He continue to brighten things for you. The holy Masses have been solved. I am sending you herewith something will, I hope be satisfac- tory in place of what you ask.
